title: In JetBrains CLion before 2026.3, 2026.2.4.1 code execution was possible in Safe Mode via a crafted GDB server debug…
description: A code execution vulnerability exists in JetBrains CLion versions before 2026.3 and 2026.2.4.1. This flaw allows code execution in Safe Mode via a crafted GDB server debug profile. The vulnerability is tracked as CVE-2026-123276 and has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.8.
